outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images (photoactivation time-lapse), not a quantitative plot, so this check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time (main plots already display individual measured data points as scatter, with fitted curves; insets show averaged time-course responses with error bars as a line-type plot). Line plots and time-course scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual data points, and the main graphs already display the raw individual data points themselves.
